halves_read: client tool and static data (zone table, item-name table, model-code table, exporter lineup, material and glow code, spawn-group chance check). Server half (Spire-driven zone/NPC/spawn database) not read; EQEmu in the box is the likely pair, not opened.

creature_families.basis: keyword match on model display names, first match wins (approximate)
robe list in the exporter; 13 model entries end in 01 (not reconciled)

top_creatures.label: Robe-swap caster body
top_creatures.why: One body with a garment variant code. The viewer decides when to show the robe from a single list, so the silhouette changes without a new body.
top_creatures.keep: One body, one swapped garment; the variant is a code, not a new asset tree.
top_creatures.change: Our robe is a hood and sash silhouette, so a caster reads at 375 wide. Not a texture swap.

top_creatures.label: Lineup of figures in one model file
top_creatures.why: Fifteen class figures and a default sit in one model file at fixed offsets, so one file serves a whole preview lineup.
top_creatures.keep: One file, several figures placed by offsets; the lineup is data.
top_creatures.change: Each figure gets its own silhouette and idle loop, and the lineup is a camera tour, not a grid.

top_creatures.label: Undead family (15 codes)
top_creatures.why: A large family of model codes. The box has the names and the count only; no stats or behaviour were read.
top_creatures.keep: A grouped family for spawn tags and pack alerts.
top_creatures.change: Our undead get one signature mark a player can read at a glance, not a shared palette.

top_creatures.label: Elemental family (12 codes)
top_creatures.why: A family that suits element-coded threat. The box holds names only; visuals not read.
top_creatures.keep: Element as the family key for hit reactions.
top_creatures.change: Colour-code by element with a shape cue too, so the code still reads without colour.

top_creatures.label: Dragon-kin family (10 codes)
top_creatures.why: A small family of large bodies. Good for a few big silhouettes that carry a fight.
top_creatures.keep: Few, large, distinct silhouettes in one family.
top_creatures.change: Fewer heads and wings; our versions have one signature horn set.

top_creatures.label: Beast family (14 codes)
top_creatures.why: Animal families are common and easy to read. The box holds names only.
top_creatures.keep: Animal families as the everyday threat set.
top_creatures.change: Different proportions and a different stance per beast; no shared rig pose.

top_creatures.label: Animated class icon loop
top_creatures.why: Fifteen short looping icons, one per class. The loop makes a static menu feel alive.
top_creatures.keep: A short loop per class icon.
top_creatures.change: Our loop shows the role state (ready, charging) rather than a pose.

top_creatures.label: Weapon-type attack slots
top_creatures.why: The animation table gives each weapon type its own attack slot, so the rig knows which attack to play.
top_creatures.keep: One attack slot per weapon family.
top_creatures.change: Our families and our animation names; no copy of the donor's slot list.

classes.name: class figure placements (15 plus default)
classes.role: grouped by name only: melee-leaning, caster-leaning, one bard-type

weapon_families.note: one-hand pierce, two-hand slash, two-hand blunt, one-hand slash, off-hand slash, bash, hand-to-hand, archery
items.json has names only; no weapon type field, so weapon families are not counted

gear_tiers.tier: armour weight ladder: cloth, leather, chain, plate
metal ladder: bronze up to adamantite
gem apex: crystal, diamond, pearl, sunstone
gear slots shown in the viewer
gear_tiers.count_hint: 7 slots: helm, chest, arms, wrists, hands, legs, feet

zones.name: zone record (610)
zones.note: short name, safe point, graveyard, level band, sky mode (0 on 309, 1 on 278, 2 on 21), time-type (0 to 5), weather and fog stages

zones.name: four-stage timed fog
zones.note: fog colour, near and far clip per stage; density 0.33 on 508 zones

zones.name: weather stages
zones.note: rain chance in some stage on 203 zones; snow on 76

looks.label: Glow include list
looks.technique: Meshes join a glow pass only when added to an include list; blur kernel 10; intensity 0.7; intensity 0 turns it off.

looks.label: Two-map water sheet
looks.technique: Water shader takes a normal map and an environment map as a pair; fresnel bias 0.11, power 8; waterfall uses four slide values.

looks.label: Glow material shininess
looks.technique: Glow-texture shader with a shininess value of 50.

looks.label: Six-face cheap sky
looks.technique: Six small JPG faces make the sky cube.

looks.label: Animated class icon loops
looks.technique: Fifteen looping GIFs, one per class icon.

looks.label: Spawn marker level-of-detail swap
looks.technique: A sphere replaces the model past a set distance, and the marker joins the glow include list.

originals.name: Dusk Clock Zone
originals.idea: Each zone holds four timed fog stages as data, keyed to one shared clock.
originals.keep: fog as a data stage per zone
originals.change: One shared dusk clock; fog never hides a telegraph.

originals.name: Weather Stage Zone
originals.idea: Rain and snow chance and duration per stage, as zone fields.
originals.keep: the data shape of weather stages
originals.change: Weather only changes sight range, never damage.

originals.name: Threat Glow
originals.idea: Targets join a glow pass only when they matter.
originals.change: Glow colour follows threat level and never hides a silhouette.

originals.name: Weighted Spawn Group
originals.idea: Spawn chances must total 100 before save.
originals.keep: the total check at edit time
originals.change: Weights feed the spawn director at runtime (row 23), not only the editor.

originals.name: Lineup Tour
originals.idea: One model file, several figures placed by offsets, shown as a camera tour.
originals.change: Each figure has its own silhouette and idle loop.

originals.name: Garment Swap Caster
originals.idea: One body, one garment variant code.
originals.change: Our swap changes the silhouette (hood, sash), not a texture.
